تشتملن (form VIII)
# تَشْتَمِلْنَ (taštamilna) /taʃ.ta.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# تُشْتَمَلْنَ (tuštamalna) /tuʃ.ta.mal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
